pages.text: $(bold)$(li)Use $(thing)chalk$(n) on a block to draw a mark. Mark the way out of a cave.$(br)$(li)Dye it for colour. Special symbols are learnt as you go.$(br)$(li)A $(thing)chalk box$(n) holds several. Add a glow ink sac and the marks glow.$(br2)All at $(l:paths/chalk)Chalk$(n), ring 2, from calcite.
